a.xlink:title: Implements request handling logic for SocketManager.
Declares the Location class for route-specific configuration.
Declares the Server class for virtual host configuration.
Immutable-ish HTTP/1.x request model with header map and parsed URL.
Declarations of helper functions for constructing HTTP responses.
Declares the SocketManager and per-client state for non-blocking I/O.
Declares the Url POD for parsed URL components.
